title: Your Loyalty Points Are Expiring — $512 Gone
hook: You've been collecting points for years thinking you're winning — and $512 of it is silently expiring before you ever use a dime.
angle: While most content focuses on earning points, this exposes the business model: $48B in unredeemed points the companies deliberately designed to expire
audience: Anyone with rewards credit cards, frequent flyer miles, or hotel points they haven't actively used recently
key_numbers: $48 billion in unredeemed US loyalty points total
$512 average per household expires unused every year
Airlines delete miles after 18 months of inactivity
Airline miles lost 43% of their value since 2015
